# PalOrbit

## PalLaw Rules Studio

PalLaw Rules Studio at https://pallaw.palorbit.app/ is a free visual editor for Palworld server rules. It creates the PalLaw.json configuration used by the PalLaw mod. Studio edits and validates rulebooks; the installed server mod enforces them.

## Editing a rulebook

Draw polygon regions on the World and World Tree maps. Configure Wilderness, Stage Areas, and region policies. Assign modes and recurring schedules, edit player actions and combat permissions, and customize player messages. Import an existing rulebook or create a new configuration. Undo and redo track local edits. Export downloads a validated PalLaw.json file.

The versioned configuration contract defines supported behavior. Do not infer additional native capabilities from the map or editor interface.

## Privacy

Studio runs in the browser without an account or backend. Drafts and theme preferences use local browser storage. Configuration contents are not uploaded. Approved fonts and icons may load from external hosts; Donate loads Ko-fi only after interaction. Browser storage belongs to the site's origin and does not automatically transfer to a different hostname. Export a rulebook before moving and import it at the destination.
